source_title: Google Pixel Watch 5 falls to $299.99, its lowest price since launch
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
The Google Pixel Watch 5 just dropped to $299.99 on Amazon, and that’s a strong deal for Google’s latest compact smartwatch. It’s $100 off the $399.99 recommended retail price, which works out to a 25% discount relative to RRP, and it’s the lowest price since launch.
The 41mm Wi-Fi model is Google’s smallest current Pixel Watch, and it’s aimed at Android users who want a Wear OS watch with Google services built in. Google also puts a big focus on on-watch Gemini AI features, which help make this feel like more than just a basic fitness tracker.
Battery life is rated at up to 30 hours with the always-on display enabled, or up to 48 hours in Battery Saver mode. On the health and safety side, the Pixel Watch 5 includes breathing-related emergency detection and expanded wellness tracking. Google also says it improves GPS accuracy and workout tracking, which adds to its appeal for runs, walks, and general fitness use.
The design stays familiar, but the compact 41mm size should be a nice fit for smaller wrists. It also has a 4.6-star Amazon rating, which adds to the appeal at this price. You can check out the deal for yourself right here on Amazon .
